items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic depth n≥0 let Hist_n=Drecord^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Raw w_n is the next unused threshold. Define the total extended wait W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0, and total real observable t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)); these zero defaults outside positive finite waits are proof observables only. Define the finite nonnegative auxiliary real-time density ρ(live(T,z),s)=λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0))) and ρ(stopped,s)=0, embedded into extended nonnegative reals. W and ρ are jointly Borel and ρ is finite everywhere. For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each d(h) finite but not necessarily uniformly bounded, set D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s). The extension ρ at nonpositive s is auxiliary and is killed by this strict guard. D_d is jointly Borel. The actual Mathlib kernel K_d=withDensity(const(Hist_n,real Lebesgue),D_d) satisfies K_d(h)=D_d(h,s)ds for every abstract history h and K_d(h,ℝ)≤1; it is a finite subprobability kernel. This equality explicitly identifies the measurable constructor branch rather than its zero fallback. Let B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗ds). B_d is Borel, X_n is Borel, (X_n)_*(P restricted to B_d)=ν_d and ν_d(Hist_n×ℝ)≤1. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], h↦∫_ℝ F(h,s)D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}} F(X_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝ F(h,s)D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability assumption on F, no positive μ_n(A), no normalized conditional probability and no finite-wait/provider hypothesis is needed; extended integrals may be infinite. Stopped histories have zero finite kernel, infinite waits fail the finite guard, and missing mass is not renormalized. The cases d(h)=0, n=0, zero hazards, rank zero and unrealizable abstract histories are included. Real Lebesgue time on the strict Ioo(0,d(h)) is exactly the already verified deterministic Ioc density reference restricted further by Iio(d(h)); no open/closed endpoint-mass equivalence or exact strict mass formula is asserted. All conclusions use the six original standing analytic hypotheses. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one finite jump-density factor implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7). Full ordered-time iteration, final survival/path functional assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual memorylessness/random restart/Markovness, global nonexplosion/invariance/hypocoercivity, implementation/error/unbounded expected cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. Adjacent survival88 is not a false proof prerequisite.
assumptions: E is finite-dimensional over ℝ with inner product and its Borel structure, including rank zero. V:E→ℝ is C².
The six standing hypotheses are α>0, α≤β, V∈C², α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v, η>0 and βη≤1; α,β≥0.
y,r,z₀ and n are deterministic and universally quantified. Actual stopped recursion and raw independent Exp1 product P are literal definitions.

d:Hist_n→NNReal is any fixed Borel finite-valued function, with no global bound; F:Hist_n×ℝ→ENNReal is jointly Borel, with no boundedness/integrability premise; A is any Borel history event, including μ_n(A)=0. These classify deterministic tests.

Joint measurability, density, unused-clock independence, kernel finite mass, no-atom estimates or conditional distributions are not supplied as premises. Strict finite component excludes stopped/infinite waits without normalization.
